register_renderer: register a renderer module and class in the RendererRegistry by renderer mode
load_renderer_cls: load a renderer class from the registry by renderer mode string
load_renderer: load and instantiate a renderer instance with config and tokenizer from the registry
renderer_from_config: create a renderer instance from a VllmConfig by resolving tokenizer and renderer mode
build_renderer_registry: build a global RendererRegistry instance with built-in renderer mappings for deepseek, hf, mistral, and qwen models
